diagnosis: The endpoint streams proprietary biometric facial recognition vector templates using req.params.vectorId from storage without checking if the authenticated user owns or is authorized to inspect the biometric template. An attacker can harvest facial feature embeddings of other users, creating a serious biometric privacy breach.
exploit_request:
GET /biometrics/vec_face_id_991823/stream-template HTTP/1.1
Host: id-verify.auth.internal:9001
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Accept: application/octet-stream
